## SEO Agent — AI Repeat Pilot (W2-E2)
**On demand only** (*Manual Run* `{ domain | site_id, confirm?, email?, callback_url? }`; no schedule). Without `confirm: true` it answers with the price (stage `ai_pilot_quote`) and asks nothing. Confirmed: 10 questions of the panel (one per topic first) x 10 asks on each engine that answers anew each time (not the AI Overview or Copilot), at most $4 -> *Pilot Metrics*: the variance between questions and within one question per engine (one-way ANOVA), the asks per question a week for +/-5 points -> callback `stage: ai_pilot`.
